Spaces A place for every kind of work From quiet research to group projects and hands-on training, Balme has dedicated spaces for students and researchers. See all spaces → Research Commons (RC) Postgraduate & faculty research work area Knowledge Commons (KC) Collaborative study area for undergraduates Instructional Lab Library instruction & training Information Access Center (IAC) Accessible to all Ghanaians Faculty Commons Dedicated quiet space for UG faculty only, away from their normal offices 24-Hour Reading Room Open to university students around the clock, seven days a week About the library The heart of the University of Ghana Library System Founded in 1948 and named after David Mowbray Balme, the University’s first Principal, the Balme Library is the main library of the University of Ghana and the largest in the University of Ghana Library System (UGLS). It holds more than 400,000 printed volumes, a growing collection of e-journals and e-books, and serves as a depository for most United Nations publications. Students and researchers also use the Research Commons, the Knowledge Commons, the Braille Library and the 24-hour reading room.
